hooks.command:
bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CWD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".cwd // empty" 2>/dev/null); REPO=${CWD:-$PWD}; TRANSCRIPT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".transcript_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); TRIGGER=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".trigger // empty" 2>/dev/null); SNAP_DIR="$REPO/.claude/sop-compact"; mkdir -p "$SNAP_DIR"; TS=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$; HANDOFF="$SNAP_DIR/handoff-$TS.md"; SOP="$REPO/.claude/sop-compact.md"; if [ ! -f "$SOP" ]; then printf "# Pre-compact handoff (stub)

_Generated %s (trigger: %s)._

No .claude/sop-compact.md found. Run /init-sop-compact to generate one.

Transcript: %s
" "$TS" "$TRIGGER" "$TRANSCRIPT" > "$HANDOFF"; exit 0; fi; PROMPT=$(printf "You are the pre-compact sidecar. Read %s for the repo procedure, then read the transcript at %s. PROMOTE principled learnings to the targets named in the SOP. Then output a dense handoff between ===HANDOFF=== and ===END=== sentinels capturing non-reconstructable in-flight context." "$SOP" "$TRANSCRIPT"); RAW=$(cd "$REPO" && timeout ${SOP_COMPACT_TIMEOUT:-600} claude -p "$PROMPT" --model ${SOP_COMPACT_MODEL:-opus} --dangerously-skip-permissions --no-chrome --no-session-persistence --strict-mcp-config --disable-slash-commands 2>/dev/null); RC=$?; if [ $RC -ne 0 ] || [ -z "$RAW" ]; then printf "# Pre-compact handoff (sidecar failed rc=%s)

_Generated %s._

Transcript: %s
" "$RC" "$TS" "$TRANSCRIPT" > "$HANDOFF"; exit 0; fi; BODY=$(printf "%s" "$RAW" | awk "/^===HANDOFF===$/{c=1;next}/^===END===$/{c=0;next}c"); if [ -n "$BODY" ]; then printf "%s
" "$BODY" > "$HANDOFF"; else printf "%s
" "$RAW" > "$HANDOFF"; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); SOURCE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".source // empty" 2>/dev/null); [ "$SOURCE" != "compact" ] && exit 0; CWD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".cwd // empty" 2>/dev/null); REPO=${CWD:-$PWD}; LATEST=$(ls -t "$REPO/.claude/sop-compact/"handoff-*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$LATEST" ]; then MSG="You were just compacted. Read $LATEST immediately for orientation. Trust: live state > handoff > summary."; else MSG="You were just compacted but no handoff found. Re-check live state before acting."; fi; jq -nc --arg ctx "$MSG" "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"SessionStart\",additionalContext:\$ctx}}"'
